item.description:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

We've deployed a small hotfix to address feedback on the Equipment and Item slot assignments.

Changes

item.title: Viractal v1.4.0 Release Notes
item.category: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?
item.description:
Hello everyone! This is the Viractal development team.

The sixth major update, Version 1.4.0, is now available!

This update introduces a brand-new Hard Mode stage, along with several new features designed to make your adventure even smoother and more strategic, including dedicated Battle Ability slots and the new Favorites Shelf feature.

New Stage: Hell
